text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Fan Appreciation Festival"—a celebration packed
with various events for the fans who support the Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the day of the event, Taiki Shuttle was also raring to go, eager to give the fans a great time.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo! It is so lively!
Every customer looks like they're having fun, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Next up is finally my turn!
I'm gonna make everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu...
That is such an exciting race!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The 'Carrot-Eating Race,' where you eat carrots placed along the track
and aim for the goal!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I've got full confidence in both my running and my eating! I'll do my best to take first place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the carrot race was underway—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: "A clean start for all Umamusume! Who will prove to have the strongest legs and the strongest stomach?!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle-san performs well on both turf and dirt, so I can't wait to see how she runs here.
choice_data_list: I won't lose, no matter what kind of race it is.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it completely makes sense
how she's grown this much.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Because I have a Trainer who believes in me this much, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A Trainer and an Umamusume run a three-legged race—without trust, her dream cannot come true.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
We're approaching the first carrot shortly!
You cannot move forward until you eat it all up!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the dangling carrots,
each Umamusume makes a graceful step! And a leeeeap!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle bit into the dangling carrot and started eating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No problem! Taiki Shuttle is the best horse girl around,
both in running speed and eating speed!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow!? Very delicious!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? All the Umamusume
are suddenly slowing their pace right here—!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Could that be... a carrot from Aichi!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
With a sugar content exceeding 15 degrees, sweeter than a watermelon...
it's the legendary carrot...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The more you chew, the more the sweetness spreads in your mouth,
so you just want to keep savoring it forever.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If something like that were placed on the track...
It would be way too delicious for us to race!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't quite get it, but seeing how passionate
Tazuna-san is getting, finishing it all must be no easy feat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... The carrots were just so delicious
that I ended up losing...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Still, all the fans
seemed to have so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I will entertain you just as much in my races...
No, no! Even more than that!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through the Fan Appreciation Festival, Taiki Shuttle
felt refreshed and more motivated than ever.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Do your best!
Taiki Shuttle-oneechan!!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: Big sis Taiki! Run, run--!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow!? Did I just accidentally
bite down on a carrot!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It's no good if I'm the only one who's happy! I'm gonna make everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Taiki Shuttle breaks away!
She's pulling ahead further and further!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I'm number one!
Thank you for cheering, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing!
Big sis is so strooong!!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
"Good luck in your next race too,
Big Sis Taiki!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay! Leave it to me, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A throng of fans surrounds Taiki Shuttle—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running seemed to be steadily
etching itself into everyone's hearts.
